      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Follows standard RPC deprecation discipline with `-deprecatedrpc=bip125` to phase out obsolete `replaceable` arguments across raw transaction and PSBT RPCs. While modifying caller-facing interfaces, the deprecation is standard and deferrable."
    },

      "rationale": "Non-member; the minor change to rbf.h is tied entirely to transaction creation RPC behavior rather than shared utility infrastructure."

      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet transaction creation RPCs in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp and src/wallet/spend.cpp.",

      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deprecates the redundant `replaceable` argument across wallet RPCs (`send`, `fundrawtransaction`, `bumpfee`) following network adoption of full-RBF as default policy.
